description: A 1HP mono mixer with four channels, each with a VCA and a mute, and a chain input for joining several of them

params.text: Sets the level of that channel
Sets the level of the output

inputs.text: A voltage controlling the level of that channel
A signal from another mixer, added to the output

outputs.text: The mix of the four channels and the chain input

notes: the panel is one unit wide and prints almost no labels; the right-click menu carries a legend headed M2 LEGENDA that names every control in order, from IN CHAIN down to OUT SIGNAL.
menu: Exponential mode — makes the level controls follow an exponential curve rather than a straight line
